The Hamiltonian of the junction is $H_0 + V$, where $H_0$ describes the decoupled leads and the
tunneling term $V$ transfers electrons between them, so it does not conserve the lead occupations.
The interaction-picture evolution operator then reduces to
\begin{equation}
e^{i H_0 t}\,e^{-i(H_0+V)t} = e^{-i V t} .
\label{eq:ui}
\end{equation}
